newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Nearly nine of 10 Taiwan students wear eyeglasses.
newsitem.headline: Nearly nine of 10 Taiwan students wear eyeglasses.

text.p: A shocking 87 percent of Taiwan's high-school students wear eyeglasses, and officials on Thursday said long hours of television viewing were to blame.
"The number is growing every year," a Taiwan provincial government official said by telephone.
A provincial study found that 87 of every 100 high school students wore corrective lenses for nearsightedness. Even in elementary schools, 30.3 of every 100 pupils wear glasses.
Altogether, 1.3 million Taiwan students have poor eyesight.
The official had no comparitive figures for other countries.
